headline: Approved Stage I school construction application to RIDE School Building Authority for projects reimbursed by Housing Aid funds.
summary: The Stage I application would let the district keep completing projects with reimbursement from RIDE Housing Aid funds. The current approval expires on 12/31/26. Members approved the application unanimously and also voted to seal executive session minutes.
decisions: Approved the August 25, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.
Approved authorization to execute and submit a Stage I Necessity of School Construction application to the RIDE School Building Authority, unanimously.
Approved sealing executive session minutes unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: A. August 25, 2026 Motion to approve: Matthew Wildenhain Second: James Chellel Yea: all Motion carries unanimously.

1. Authorization to Execute and Submit a Necessity of School Construction Stage I Application to the RIDE School Building Authority ... Motion to approve: Matthew Wildenhain Second: Juan Pablo Barrera Yea: All Motion carries unanimously.
1. Approving to seal Executive Session minutes Motion to seal: Juan Pablo Barrera Second: Kimberly Grant Yea: All Motion carries unanimously.
